LESSON: MASS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Measurements
Topic 2.2: Mass
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, part of Measurements in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: How can you compare the mass of two or more objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mass together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Speaking skills as a learner contributes to a group discussion and use safe objects to identify those

heavier than, lighter than or same as.

● Digital Literacy: learner uses digital devices to play games involving mass.

Values:
● Integrity: shares equally identified empty containers to measure the mass of other objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental Education and Climate Change as learners collect containers to be used and properly dispose or recycle them after use.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learner relates skills in measuring mass and different containers to consumer education containers and packets in Environmental activities.
